expect.summary: Email is given but the toll-free number is never said. Contact item missing, first charge held until a supervisor overrides.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Thanks for calling GoGoGrandparent, this is Dana. This call is recorded. How can I help today?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I saw your ad in the senior center newsletter. I'm Gloria Pratt and I want to join.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Wonderful, Gloria. GoGo lets you book rides and order groceries and meals by phone, with no smartphone app. You call or text us, we book the ride with a driver service, and we keep an eye on the trip.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: The Basic plan is $14.00 per month, billed monthly.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Your membership automatically renews every month unless you cancel.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: You can cancel any time with no fee. If you want to cancel, email us at support@gogograndparent.com or cancel online in your account settings.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Our Terms include an arbitration agreement and a class action waiver, so disputes go to individual arbitration instead of court.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Gloria, do you authorize GoGoGrandparent to charge your debit card ending in 5120 $14.00 today and every month until you cancel?

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Thank you, Gloria. Your written confirmation will come by mail before the first charge.
